rationale: Both describe increased homocysteine/plasma HCY levels using different wording.
Both describe reduction in progesterone synthesis/levels, representing the same biological outcome.
Reduction in melanin level and reduction in melanosome level are closely linked and describe the same pigmentation loss process at near-synonym specificity.
Both describe dysregulation/impairment of ACE2 expression and activity using different wording.

These events all concern ACE2 expression/activity changes but 1787 specifies downregulation (directional decrease) while 1854/1740 describe dysregulation, representing different processes on the same object.
Both describe increased Angiotensin II / plasma Ang II levels.
Both concern the AT1R receptor but one describes agonist binding and the other describes receptor upregulation, which are distinct processes on the same object.
Both involve ACE2 as the target but binding to ACE2 and SARS-CoV-2 cell entry are distinct processes.
Decreased RA synthesis and decreased plasma RA level describe the same directional outcome of reduced retinoic acid availability.
Retinaldehyde dehydrogenase inhibition is upstream of decreased RA synthesis; they share the same pathway object but represent distinct processes.
Both concern DNA methyltransferase but one describes increased expression and the other describes inhibition, which are directionally opposite effects on the same enzyme.
Both describe increased caspase transcription but 1779 specifies the F3 generational context while 1774 is the general event.
Both describe increased ovarian somatic cell apoptosis but 1783 specifies the F3 generational context.
Both describe increased ovarian follicle breakdown but 1784 specifies the F3 generational context.
Both describe decreased fecundity but 1781 specifies the F3 generational context.
Both describe F3 generational reproductive impairment (oogenesis and oocyte apoptosis) but these are distinct processes; however 1780 and 1782 both specify F3 context for oocyte-level events.
Both describe impaired/decreased spermatogenesis using different wording.
Both involve Toll-Like Receptors but 1706 describes TLR7/8 stimulation (activation) while 1848 describes TLR dysregulation, which are distinct processes on the same receptor family.
Both concern TLR9 but 1842 describes prolonged TLR9 activation generally while 1900 specifies increased platelet surface TLR9 expression, a cell-specific context.

Blockade of STAT5 phosphorylation and suppression of STAT5 binding to cytokine gene promoters both describe downstream consequences of STAT5 inhibition and together constitute the same functional impairment.
Inhibition of chitin synthase 1 and decrease in cuticular chitin content share the same biological object/outcome area but represent cause (enzyme inhibition) vs. effect (substrate decrease).
Inhibition of chitinase and inhibition of chitobiase are both chitin-degrading enzyme inhibitions in the same molting pathway and are closely related enzymatic steps often grouped together.
Sulfonylurea receptor binding and opening of voltage-dependent calcium channel are linked but represent distinct molecular processes (receptor binding vs. channel gating).
CYP17A1 inhibition leads to reduction in DHEA and androstenedione, but enzyme inhibition and substrate/product level changes are distinct processes on different objects.
Decreased DHT levels and decreased anogenital distance are not synonyms — withdrawing this grouping as AGD is a phenotypic outcome not equivalent to DHT levels.
Impaired inguinoscrotal testicular descent and cryptorchidism/maldescended testis describe the same anatomical defect at different levels of description.
Reduction in pigmentation pattern and reduction in melanin level describe the same directional loss of pigmentation.
Tyrosinase inhibition and reduction of L-Dopaquinone share the same enzymatic pathway but represent enzyme inhibition vs. substrate/product reduction, which are distinct processes.
Increase in RONS and increase in oxidative DNA damage are causally related but represent different biological objects/processes (reactive species vs. DNA damage).
Oxidation of membrane lipids and increase in lipid peroxidation describe closely related processes on the same biological substrate and could be merged, but one specifies membrane context.
Decrease in acyl-CoA dehydrogenases and decreased mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation share the same biological context but represent enzyme-level vs. pathway-level changes.
Porcupine-induced Wnt secretion/signaling activation and beta-catenin activation are sequential steps in the same pathway but represent distinct molecular processes.
Abnormalities in cardiac outflow tract formation and congenital cardiac conotruncal anomalies describe the same structural heart defect using different terminology.
Disruption of progenitor cells of the second heart field and impairment of fourth pharyngeal arch development are related developmental processes but involve distinct biological structures.
Both describe mis-timed ecdysone receptor-responsive nuclear receptor cascade but in opposite directions (increase vs. decrease).
Both describe seizure-related neurological events but focal seizure and status epilepticus represent different severity/type of the same epileptic phenomenon.
Impaired gustatory nerve and dysgeusia (taste disturbance) are causally related but represent distinct biological events (nerve impairment vs. clinical symptom).

Thyroid receptor antagonism, displacement of T4 from carrier protein, and binding to thyroid binding globulin all involve thyroid hormone system components but are distinct molecular processes on different objects.
Displacement of serum T4 from carrier protein and binding to thyroid binding globulin in serum describe related but mechanistically distinct interactions with the same carrier protein.
Increase in apoptosis and apoptotic cell death describe the same biological event of programmed cell death.
Both describe inflammation but 902 specifies liver inflammation while 1633 is a general increase in inflammation.
Increased inflammatory immune responses and hyperinflammation describe the same directional increase in inflammatory response using different terminology.
NF-kB activation and Activator protein 1 (AP-1) activation are related transcription factor activations in inflammatory signaling but are distinct molecular entities.
Both describe decreased cortisol levels — 1835 includes 11β-(OH) testosterone as well but both capture the same directional cortisol reduction outcome.
Inhibition of 11β-HSD and inhibition of 11β-hydroxylase are related steroidogenic enzyme inhibitions but are distinct enzymes (dehydrogenase vs. hydroxylase) and thus different biological objects.
Inhibition of lung surfactant function and alveolar collapse are causally related but represent distinct biological events (molecular inhibition vs. structural collapse).
Suppression of IL-4 production and increase of Th2 cells producing IL-4 describe opposite effects on IL-4 in different contexts but are not strict directional opposites of the same endpoint.
Increase in extracellular matrix deposition and activation of stellate cells are related in fibrosis pathways but represent distinct biological events (ECM accumulation vs. cell activation).

Acinar cell proliferation and pancreatic acinar cell tumors are causally related events but represent distinct biological processes (proliferation vs. neoplastic transformation) in the same cell type.
Accumulation of misfolded proteins and endoplasmic reticulum stress are closely related but represent distinct cellular events (protein quality control vs. ER stress response).
D1 protein deactivation and decrease in Photosystem II efficiency are causally linked events in the same complex but represent distinct processes (protein inactivation vs. complex efficiency).
Reduced sperm count and impaired spermatogenesis are related reproductive endpoints but represent an outcome measure vs. a process, not strict synonyms.
Increased hypermethylation of the GnRH receptor promoter region and decreased expression of GnRH receptor describe sequential steps of the same epigenetic silencing event on the same gene.

Both describe decreased androgen levels but 2298 specifies intratesticular testosterone and 1756 specifies plasma 11-ketotestosterone, representing the same directional change in different compartments/androgens.
Multi-organ failure involving ARDS and increased risk of acute respiratory failure are related but distinct clinical outcomes differing in scope and severity.
Coagulation and thrombosis/DIC are related but distinct pathological processes; coagulation is a process while thrombosis/DIC is a downstream clinical outcome.
